doc: Closed-cell size field (8 to 32 km, a factor 4 in size) on 64x64: values between 0.0334 and 0.1317 tile units (bounds 0.0333 and 0.1333), log-uniform and smooth. exp(log(km0/240) + (log(km1/240) - log(km0/240)) u), with u = _uniform(size, 1.0, seed) (slope 3); REFERENCE_TILE_KM = 240 is read from the source. The fBm white noise is the input plan0.white. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max relative |diff| 1.1e-15 (5.3e-15 on the 5-decade case), so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute.
